project.Title: Expeditions Town Events Hints
project.ItemDescription:
[h3]What the mod does[/h3]
Show hints for Quests that result in Town Event.
[b]Before[/b] Town Event: Silence in the Crypts
[b]After[/b] Town Event: Silence in the Crypts Ruins: +33% Resolve XP, +15% DMG
[b]Affected Expeditions[/b] Activate quests: Silence in the Crypts, Sunshine in the Thicket, Gentle Tide, Fresh Air in the Tunnels. Gather quests: All Saints Day, Caregivers Convention, Lost and Found, Bumper Crop.
[h3]Compatibility[/h3] It is a localization override of the eight event title strings - no gameplay changes, so should be safe with most other mods.
It is advised to put this closer to the top so it correctly works with bigger overhaul mods and doesn't get rewritten. "UI Enhancement" is one example of a mod that should be below in Load Order to make everything work.
Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.
[h3]Bugs[/h3] Because the title strings are shared, the effect lines also appear in the town event announcement and in the activity log entry for these eight events.
[h3]Playing non-english?[/h3] Playing in another language? Use "Expeditions Town Events Hints (International)" instead. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3791806160
[h3]Source Code[/h3] https://github.com/Vergir/DD-ExpeditionsTownEventsHints Also MIT licensed, so hack away.
[h3]AI Usage[/h3] AI was heavily used to write code, rephrase words for a better fit and to write docs. AI was not used for icon art.
